Constructor Detail

DEditor

public DEditor(java.lang.String curDirString,
               java.lang.String configFile,
               java.lang.String filename,
               java.lang.String schemaFilename,
               boolean allowNewFile,
               boolean allowOpenFile,
               boolean allowLoadSchema,
               boolean relaxed,
               model.DEditPlugin plugin,
               javax.swing.JApplet applet)
Constructor for the top-level class. Sets up all GUI components.

Parameters:
curDirString - the current directory the user is running in
configFile - name of an XML file to use for configuration of DEditor
filename - name of an XML file to open if non-null
schemaFilename - name of an XML Schema file to open
allowNewFile - true if user will be allowed to makenew files
allowOpenFile - true if user will be allowed to open files
allowLoadSchema - true if user will be allowed to load schemas
relaxed - true if the Editor should run in relaxed verification mode (see ???README)
applet - the applet (if any) that this DEditor is running from
Method Detail

addIconButton

public void addIconButton(javax.swing.JButton button)
Adds a JButton (which should have an associated icon) to the icon button panel at the top of the window. Any text will be removed and the icon will be resized to fit existing buttons. As this is done only once, before JFrame.show(), it's acceptable to use smooth scaling.

Parameters:
button - the JButton to add to the button panel

writeRemoteFile

public void writeRemoteFile(java.lang.String filename,
                            java.lang.String contents)
Writes a remote file using the servlet from BhpViewer.

Parameters:
filename - the name of the file to write
contents - the contents of the file to write

getRemoteFileInputStream

public java.io.InputStream getRemoteFileInputStream(java.lang.String filename)
Gets the InputStream containing data from the remote file specified by "filename" using the servlet from BhpViewer

Parameters:
filename - the name of the remote file whose data will be retrievable through the returned InputStream
Returns:
an InputStream containing the data from file "filename"

readRemoteFile

public java.lang.String readRemoteFile(java.lang.String filename)
Reads the contents of a remote file and returns them as a String using the servlet from BhpViewer to get the InputStream containing the data (with getRemoteFileInputStream(String)).

Parameters:
filename - the name of the file whose contents will be retrieved
Returns:
the contents of "filename" as a String

changeEditOptions

public void changeEditOptions()
Changes the available options under the edit menu based on the currently selected DEditXMLWindow.

changeEditOptions

public void changeEditOptions(model.DEditXMLWindow window)
Helper or regularly called method which changes the edit options for the passed in DEditXMLWindow which should in all cases == getSelectedWindow().

Parameters:
window - the currently selected DEditXMLWindow, == getSelectedWindow()

changeEditOptions

public void changeEditOptions(model.DEditXMLWindow window,
                              model.DEditNode[] selectedNodes)
Changes the available options under the edit menu based on the input DEditXMLWindow (which should be the currently selected DEditXMLWindow) and the given selected nodes. If more than one node is selected, only copy and cut can be chooseable.

Parameters:
window - the DEditXMLWindow to use to determine what's allowable -- should be the currently selected DEditXMLWindow
selectedNodes - the currently selected DEditNodes

getProperty

public java.lang.String getProperty(java.lang.String propName)
Returns a property value, which only has meaning when running as an applet or when that property has earlier been set with a call to setProperty(). First this function tries to get a value from a previous setProperty(). If that fails and it is an applet, it tries applet.getParameters(propName).

Parameters:
propName - the name of the property to retrieve
Returns:
the value for the input property

setProperty

public void setProperty(java.lang.String propName,
                        java.lang.String value)
Sets the value for a property so that the next call to getProperty() for that property name will return the value input here. For an applet this overrides the property of the parameter by name "propName " for that applet

Parameters:
propName - the name of the property to set
value - the value to set property "propName" to

main

public static void main(java.lang.String[] args)
Command line invoked function which calls makeDEditor(args,null,null). This means that the DEditPlugin and JApplet are null, but a command line option may specify the plugin.

Parameters:
args - arguments to be used to configure the DEditor.

makeDEditor

public static model.DEditor makeDEditor(java.lang.String[] args,
                                        model.DEditPlugin plugin,
                                        javax.swing.JApplet applet)
Makes a DEditor much which can be start()ed and places extra arguments not used by it into any plugins or into the input vector if there are no plugins

Parameters:
args - command line arguments
plugin - a pre-existing plugin to be used if none is specified by args
applet - the applet this DEditor should run in (runs as an application if null)
Returns:
a DEditor ready to be used
